<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2 bootstrap</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Initialize game with preserved progression and persistence
    const game = {
      // Preserved game state and progression
      saveState: {
        player: {
          health: 100,
          energy: 100,
          level: 1
        },
        enemies: [
          { id: 1, type: 'slime', health: 10 },
          { id: 2, type: 'pirate', health: 20 }
        ],
        progress: {
          completed: 0,
          total: 100
        }
      },
      // Preserved gameplay mechanics
      mechanics: {
        combat: {
          attack: () => {
            // Preserved combat logic
          },
          defense: () => {
            // Preserved defense logic
          }
        },
        progression: {
          move: () => {
            // Preserved progression logic
          },
          upgrade: () => {
            // Preserved upgrade logic
          }
        }
      }
    };

    // Initialize game UI and layout
    const ui = {
      healthBar: document.createElement('div'),
      energyBar: document.createElement('div'),
      levelDisplay: document.createElement('div'),
      enemyList: document.createElement('div')
    };

    // Add to game container
    document.getElementById('game').appendChild(ui.healthBar);
    document.getElementById('game').appendChild(ui.energyBar);
    document.getElementById('game').appendChild(ui.levelDisplay);
    document.getElementById('game').appendChild(ui.enemyList);

    // Initialize game with preserved state
    game.saveState.player.health = 100;
    game.saveState.player.energy = 100;
    game.saveState.player.level = 1;

    // Add enemies
    game.enemies.forEach(enemy => {
      const enemyDiv = document.createElement('div');
      enemyDiv.textContent = `Enemy ${enemy.id}`;
      ui.enemyList.appendChild(enemyDiv);
    });

    // Initialize game with preserved mechanics
    game.mechanics.combat.attack();
    game.mechanics.combat.defense();
    game.mechanics.progression.move();
    game.mechanics.progression.upgrade();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
